entries.title: Nightmare Reaper

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original full-release platform with native PC settings/capture flexibility and current PC update support, while the console ports do not have exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Nightmare Reaper on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.
